title: Spicy Moroccan Macaroni
description: A flavorful and spicy pasta dish inspired by Moroccan cuisine. This recipe combines the comfort of macaroni with the bold flavors of North Africa.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the seffa over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chili flakes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked macaroni to the skillet and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the macaroni is well coated and heated through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
